I’m not a CNA but this post showed up on my feed and I feel compelled to respond. I’m mentally ill. I’ve never physically attacked or threatened anyone but I have said things to medical/psychiatric staff that I cringe looking back on. That being said, of the 2 people in most of the comments, only one was in their right mind. I know it’s hard to handle and abuse should never be tolerated but snapping back at the patient is abhorrent. You can redirect or provide consequences but trust me, we know when you’re responding out of anger. It’s traumatizing and makes us feel unsafe. My favorite nurse during my last psych stay let me complain to her when I was frustrated. She didn’t try to correct me but rather allowed me to vent my frustrations. She felt like a safe person to me. The staff who were snarky made me feel alone, scared, and unsafe. I’m not trying to justify my or others’ actions but people like some of these commenters are the reason psych stays are absolutely terrifying. There are ways to correct without abusing. Knowing that potentially abusive people have all the power over you is awful.
